title: Skill Sense Traps
wikitext:
This skill will allow you sense any traps in a zone via changing your direction to face the trap.

This skill can be increased by binding it to a movement key in your Everquest options.

* Using this skill does not drop Hide or Sneak

== Classes ==

* [[Rogue]] (Level: 10)
* [[Bard]] (Level: 20)
